project.title: aquascape-wood-v2-views
project.description: Source-matched supplementary artwork for the accepted operator-reviewed V2 individual. Follow the exact master identity and pixel-art drawing.
project.art_direction: Retain the supplied master artwork's naturalistic detailed pixel art, coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters and restrained palette. No CGI or photographic noise.
project.session_goal: Source-matched supplementary views/parts for artwork-led 3D construction.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

assets.name: wood_back
assets.description: View the EXACT same driftwood from the OPPOSITE BACK side, orthographic camera level. Preserve every major branch, the twisted S main limb, bulging root crotch, short upward fork, stabilizing roots and frayed broken ends. This reverses left-right relative to the front image: long main branch now reaches to viewer LEFT and knotted base is to viewer RIGHT. Reveal the actual rear grain and root connection, no redesign. IMPORTANT: exact same individual driftwood and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

assets.name: wood_top
assets.description: View the EXACT same driftwood directly from ABOVE, orthographic top plan. Keep master's left-right orientation, the main long limb runs LEFT to RIGHT and the knotted swollen crotch stays left of center. The whole root's front-back footprint is roughly half its full length. Preserve the locations of main branch junctions and root forks, realistic twisting continuous growth, no new branches. IMPORTANT: exact same individual driftwood and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

assets.name: wood_right
assets.description: View the EXACT same driftwood from its RIGHT END, orthographic level end elevation. Its long main limb is strongly foreshortened pointing almost toward viewer; show irregular root crotch behind and the upward fork above. Preserve exact thick wood body and branch inventory; do not rotate to a pleasing broadside. This is an end view used to resolve depth. IMPORTANT: exact same individual driftwood and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.
